recognize_zh: 視野中大量大型原紅血球：圓核、細緻染色質、胞質呈深藍色且邊緣更藍，部分有核周淡染區，旁邊夾雜較成熟的紅血球母細胞（棋盤狀染色質），呈現紅血球系大量增生的母細胞族群。
features: Numerous large proerythroblasts with high N:C ratio, round central nuclei, and fine chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm, darker at the periphery, with occasional perinuclear pallor
Admixed later erythroblasts with coarse checkered chromatin and polychromatic cytoplasm
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; granulocytic precursors are infrequent
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of large immature erythroid cells. The predominant cells are proerythroblasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous to small nucleoli, and a rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm, with occasional small vacuoles. Maturing basophilic and polychromatic erythroblasts with clumped chromatin are admixed, while myeloid precursors are scant. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia (pure erythroid type).

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have less basophilic cytoplasm, may contain granules or Auer rods, and are MPO/CD13/CD33 positive rather than CD71/glycophorin A/E-cadherin positive.
Megaloblastic anemia shows full erythroid maturation with giant bands and hypersegmented neutrophils rather than a predominance of proerythroblasts.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19-associated pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Giant pronormoblasts with viral inclusions are scattered among a marrow lacking later erythroid stages, not sheets of proerythroblasts with dysplastic maturation.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clusters and lack erythroid markers, whereas these cells are dispersed and show a continuum of erythroid maturation.
